title: Representative normalization for the transported published tensor comparison
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, and a scheme morphism f:X→Y. For any flat K-flat independent coefficient complexes P,Q on the sequence site of Y, the transported ambient tensor comparison, followed by the derived inverse-image maps on both factors, equals the inverse-image map followed by the sequence tensor cochain map and the tensor model at X. Explicitly this is the representative rectangle displayed by publishedSystemTransportedTensor_normalized, with the K-flat hypotheses hP and hQ.

source.place: Tags 03D3, 03EL, 07A4 and 07A7, representative normalization of the tensor pullback comparison.

proof.text: First establish the flat-term representative rectangle, then apply K-flat tensor descent to identify the transported comparison with the canonical sequence comparison. Substitute that equality into the defining representative equation of pullbackTensorSystemComparison.

proof_origin.place: Representative normalization of the tensor pullback comparison on flat K-flat complexes.
